press_references.value: Mantas Launches Parametric Insurance for Cloud Outages with $1.77M Seed Funding

product_launches.description: Mantas launched from stealth and introduced a new parametric insurance product for cloud outages, offering automatic payouts based on verified outage data and real-time cloud risk monitoring for digital-first companies.

overview_description.description:
Cloud outage is one of the most predictable risks facing businesses today, and one of the most underinsured.

Mantas is an insurtech that designs parametric insurance for cloud-first businesses. Pre-defined triggers, real-time monitoring, and swift payouts without delays.
